current.thesis: One active manuscript at thesis.md. The protected message is a standalone endpoint object; identity/key trust, authentication, decryption, multipart association, reconstruction and acceptance remain endpoint responsibilities.
current.architecture: No server, directory, database, index, fixed address, rendezvous service, coordinator, orchestration service or external resolver is required for message identity, key resolution, decryption, fragment membership, reconstruction or acceptance. External routes convey or withhold bytes; they do not establish message identity, membership or acceptance.
current.multipart: Whole-object representation remains baseline. Sender-selectable segmentation is optional and independent of carrier/transport. Any required authenticated membership and reconstruction context travels within the protected representation.
current.route_acquisition: Recipient acquisition is a route-specific delivery condition and comparative observer topic, not a message-protocol function. External discovery/retrieval systems remain prior-art comparators only.
current.prior_art: OMR/APIR/AAD/vPIR/range-query systems remain comparative prior art only. Former Candidate D is retired; no server/database composition or subsystem is proposed.
current.supplied_papers: 910.pdf maps to SRC-051 UnifOMR; 2369.pdf and StOMR-camera-ready.pdf map to SRC-050 StOMR; sensors-24-00627-v2.pdf maps to SRC-043 multi-image robust fragment hiding. These are already represented in the research record.
current.sony_comparison: SRC-061 and prior-art-comparison §3.8 record Sony's 1999 Galaxy-group and 2001 VWM-group participation, separate 2005 Academy screener recipient-watermark reporting, and the author's reported Sony R&D experience as context only. Bounded finding integrated into thesis §8.3, W1, W4, observer/property matrix, contribution assessment and RQ6 traceability. No claim that Sony developed the screener system or that the programmes were identical.
current.evidence_limits: No implementation, experiment, formal proof, platform deployment test, independent review or security audit.

invariants: Message is self-contained; endpoint-held keys and local trust state supply cryptographic authority.
No server/address/directory/database/rendezvous relationship is required for decryption or multipart reconstruction.
External routes convey or withhold bytes; they do not establish message identity, membership or acceptance.
Carrier uniqueness, variable placement, concealment and extra hops do not imply anonymity or security.
Preserve source provenance and distinguish source-inspected, tested, reproduced, audited and independently reviewed.
